Sarah — really appreciate the clear asks and timeline. High level response below; I'll loop in finance and legal to convert to a formal redline.

Short answer: we can do a structured 2-year prepay with tranche guarantees, but it will be conditional on (a) defined minimum monthly tranche levels, (b) an accelerators/escalator for usage above committed tiers, and (c) a one-time SLA addendum with a capped credit (not unlimited).

Proposed outline (subject to approval):
- Term: 24 months prepaid commitment with quarterly tranche protection (we guarantee capacity for the committed tranche each quarter).
- Discount: 5.5% blended term discount for 2-year prepay (we can improve if payment is fully upfront vs split).
- Ramp: Year 1 baseline + 10% optional growth per quarter; Year 2 baseline with 5% floor on monthly commitment.
- SLA: Addendum limited to 5% credit of quarterly prepay for defined latency SLO misses; credit applied as future usage credit.

I've attached a draft with the core language (redwood-draft-2yr-prepay-term.pdf) and will ask legal to produce a redline. If you're open to a 60/40 split (60% upfront, 40% at 12 months), we can move to 6% discount.

Next steps: I'll escalate to Vivek (sales) and Priyom (finance) for approvals; Kimberly (legal) will handle the SLA wording. Would you be available for a 30-min call on Thursday 10/15 to lock the commercial structure?

Best,

Sarah / Dylan — quick note from the commercial side. I'm supportive of a tranche-backed 2yr prepay but want to be explicit about tradeoffs so OrbitHealth has full visibility: 

1) Pricing: We can match 6% if OrbitHealth agrees to either (A) 100% upfront payment, or (B) a 65/35 split with the 65% on signing and the remainder at 12 months. For a pure 60/40 split Dylan proposed, we can do 5.75%.

2) Capacity guarantee: We will guarantee capacity up to the committed monthly tranche. Any usage beyond that will be billed at list with a credit applied to next quarter when threshold exceeded (this keeps burst protection but preserves fairness).

3) SLA: We will provide a separate SLA addendum that contains a defined latency SLO window tied to primary region; credit capped at 5% of the affected quarter and applied as future usage credit only. No cash refunds.

4) Audit & data retention: Finance may request audit rights for usage reconciliation if Orbit requests unusual invoice smoothing.

If OrbitHealth is comfortable with 65/35 and the 5% credit cap, we can finalize commercial and I'll authorize the 6% blended discount. Otherwise, Priyom's team will need to run scenario on cashflow implications.

— Vivek

Folks — finance checklist and conditions if we're offering a 6% blended discount at 65/35 split:

1) Payment schedule: 65% due on signature, remaining 35% due at 12 months. For 100% upfront we'll do 6.5% discount but require wire-only (no credit card).
2) Escrow/reconciliation: We need the right to reconcile usage monthly with a 60-day lookback and to apply true-ups against the second tranche.
3) Audit: OrbitHealth must allow an annual usage audit (or provide equivalent invoices/metrics) for reconciliation. Any overages >10% will be charged at list with no retro credits except the agreed quarterly mechanism.
4) Credit note treatment: SLA credit must be applied as account credit only; it cannot reduce past invoices.

If Orbit signs up to the above and legal signs the SLA addendum, finance approves the exception. Happy to join a call to run the cashflow model.
